1.c4 g6 2.Nc3 Bg7 3.g3.strategy: Prepares to fianchetto the king's bishop, mirroring Black's set-up, and holds back the central pawns. White aims for a flexible, slower game in which the bishop on the long diagonal presses on d5 and the queenside, and the choice of central set-up stays open.

1.c4 g6 2.Nc3 Bg7 3.g3 Nf6.strategy: Develops the knight to a square that watches e4 and d5, the squares White's centre needs, and clears the way for castling. Black commits to nothing in the centre and stays flexible against White's slower build-up.
